versions.short: The law directs the National Travel and Tourism Office in the Department of Commerce to promote travel to music festivals, concert venues, and other music-related places in the United States, both for domestic and international visitors. It also expands the office's existing work on sports and recreation so that it covers promoting international travel to those activities in the United States. The office must report its activities and findings to Congress within one year of the law's enactment and then every two years after that.
